name: Myra
line: Myra was a city in Lycia, near the sea in what is now called Asia Minor, where Paul and the others moved to a ship headed for Italy.

moments.title: Paul arrives at Myra
moments.text: After sailing across the open sea off Cilicia and Pamphylia, Paul and those with him came to Myra in Lycia.

moments.title: A ship bound for Italy
moments.text: At Myra the Roman officer found a ship from Alexandria sailing for Italy and put Paul and the others on board.
